content: Jesu Yobalisa Omulume Osikutoma
Eliywaa linjili no Pumulo abo Jesu aba ana kuta mu ndoo no mubusisi no Afalisi okalya esinkwa, onje amwalikete.
Kamumone, sebeli kwiiya kwa yonyene omulume woyo ona kutimbanga amakondo ni makaa.
Cwale Jesu sebeli wamba kwa simulawo na Falisi nji, “Kana kame kufanena okubalisa eli no Pumulo?
Kono onyene sebeli aondoka feela. Cwale Jesu sebeli oshimba omulume woyo ni kumu balisa mane ni kumu lukulula nji akutele.
Cwale sebeli wamba kwa onyene nji, “Cwale anyine kwaanyi woyo okwite mwanaye simba opulu waye ona kwele mu wina woyo sokwangwa okumu tundisamo eli no Pumulo?”
Kono kasi kutwesa oku mutambula epuzo yaye eyo.
Okukokobeza ni Kamuhelo
Cwale sebeli wambela awo ana kwisaniwa ku mukiti enguli nji, aba ana kumona omo ana kukuketela eibaka no kukutekeha, sebeli wamba kwa onyene nji,
“Nji kame ona memiwa ku mukiti no likwala, olese okwikala esipula no kukutekeha. Kakuli kame kutwesahala nji mwendi omunu no utokwa okubita wena ni yonyene namemiwa,
mi cwale woyo ona mimeme monje mbaiyi ni kwamba kwaanyi nji, ‘Mube wuyu mulume esipula esi cwale wene mbweene ba kwikala ba sipula no sibaka na kundi.

Kono cwale nji numemiwa, okaikale ba sipula na kunji nji cwale omunya mukiti aba saiye kame saambe kwa wene nji, ‘Mulikani ote okaikale ba sipula na balubala,’ mi cwale mbukutekehe mu miyo aawo aikalile onje ba tafule.
Cwale omunu yonje woyo oku nuneka mba kokobeziwa, mi woyo oku kokobeza mba nunekiwa.

Cwale Jesu sebeli wamba ngeeso ku mulume ona kumumema nji, “Cwale aba uba omukushuko simba omulalelo, olese okumema alikani owe, simba abowe, mane simba awo oyakile noo ano kufuma, kakuli nonyene mbaa kumeme eliywaa linjili muku kuuseta mi watenekiwa kale.
Kono cwale aba otenda omukiti, omeme awo ashebile, eiyanga, eihole mane ni ibofu,
cwale mukutenda ngeeso mbu fuyauliwa, kakuli katwese oukuuseta. Mi mbu tenekiwa mu niti ba liywaa no kwinguka no aafu.”
Enguli no Mukiti no Kuneneba
Omunjili kwawo ana kwikala naye ba tafule sebeli oyupa eyi, mi sebeli wamba kwa Jesu nji, “Embuyoti niya woyo sokalya esinkwa mu mubuso wa Nyambe!”
Kono Jesu sebeli wamba kwa yonyene nji, “Kame kuna kwikalanga omulume woyo ona kutenda omukiti no kuneneba, mi sebeli omema aanu no kupula.
Cwale enako no mukiti aba inaku keela sebeli otuma omubika waye okambela awo onje ana kwisaniwa nji, ‘Komwiye cwale einu yonje yaluka kale!’
Kono cwale onje sebeli atateka okuba amabaka. Woyo no weli sebeli wamba ku mubika nji, ‘Kame nina ulu elitema mi kame nisinga nji nite ni kalimone, kame ni lapela nji munilemene.’
Omunjili ni yonyene sebeli wamba nji, ‘Kame nina ulu eipani no mapulu no kukwana itanu mi kame nisinga nji ni kayeteke, cwale muyupe okukumbela kwange.’
Omunjili kame sebeli wamba nji, ‘Abano okubinda ni kwate, mulibaka elyo sitwese okwiiya.

Cwale omubika sebeli oukamo nukambele molyaye. Cwale omolyaye sebeli ofilikana ni kwambela omubika waye nji, ‘Kandi cwale olelube ote mu makululu mane ni misika mi okashimbe ano kusheeba, eiyanga, eihole mane nawo no kwa mona aiye ku mukiti.’
Cwale omubika sebeli wamba nji, ‘Molyange eyi ona nambele naitendahala kono kame kusisiyalile esibaka.’
Cwale omolyaye sebeli wamba ku mubika waye nji, ‘Ote mu mikwakwa ni mu mikulo okandimeke aanu aiye mukwingena, nji endoo yange iiyale.
Kakuli kame ni kwambela nji kakwisa kwaawo aanu nina kumema oweli awo saiye mukulya ku silya sange!’”
Cwale enyangela sebeli imukon̄a mi Jesu sebeli ofutukela kwaanu ni kwamba nji,
“Nji omunu kame aiya kwa mene mi katimbi sitaye, inawaye, mukataye, anaye mane nainaye nakulwaye, ee simba mane ni mooyo waye, katamba kutenda omwiyetwa wange.
Nji omunu yonje kashimbi esifapahano saye ni kuni kon̄a katamba kutenda omwiyetwa wange.
Cwale anyine mukaci kenu woyo otwesa okuyaka etawala yokasiikala banji nji amone etisinyehelo taye eto satitwese okumana omusebezi waye?
Kono cwale aba abeeka amatatekelo no muyako, mi katwese oku umanenena, awo onje aumona kame atateka oku musheka.
Mbaamba nji, ‘Wuyu mulume nakutateka okuyaka kono kame ana kwangwa okumanenena.

Simba anyine ombumu woyo ota okalwisa omukwaye woyo nokwatwesa okwikala banji ni kunahana nji kana kame atwesa okalwa ni sikwata saye no kukwana eikiti likumi nji aka kuwane ni woyo okwite esikwata no kukwana eikiti makumi ayiili.
Cwale nji otwesa abo omunjili yonyene kame amubita, mba tumu ondumeleti okakumbela ekozo asili kule.
Cwalehe omunu yonje kwaanyi kakutoboha oufumu waye katamba okutenda omwiyetwa waye.
Omungwa no Kwamuba
“Omungwa ni wakuwaba, kono nji waamuba kale, cwale ngasibine sausetwe nji mungwa kame?
Kaukwite etuso ku mumbu simba ku mununo, aanu kame auyumba. Cwale woyo okwite amatwi ayupe.”
